projects.title: JAFIN-NG
projects.subtitle: Next-generation public bank of Serbia
projects.summary: Replacing a 20-year-old government bank with a new one, built from scratch for the entire country.
projects.body:
Development is projected to last for almost a decade.

- **2025** Treasury tariffs, cash operations, BU/BA production
- **2024** Payment gateway, BRA/APR integration, performance tests
- **2023** Budget users registry, bank accounts registry, data tables, reports, i18n
- **2022** System analysis, backend concepts, framework design
- **2021** Analysis and documentation of the current system

projects.title: TBASS
projects.subtitle: Treasury Bank Account Statement Service
projects.summary: Daily statements for 200K+ public fund accounts in four formats, on a single commodity server, in under an hour.
projects.body: Replaced a dozen home-grown systems that took hours, sometimes days, to produce the same data. The critical run happens around 1 AM and must have no errors of any kind, so the team built notification tools that make sure somebody wakes up if it fails.

projects.title: IDP
projects.subtitle: Government Subsidy Registry
projects.summary: COVID-19 aid for every citizen. Built in one month; registered 2M people in a few hours without downtime.
projects.body:
Expectations were unreal: done within a single month, millions of requests in a single day, integration with all banks and dozens of ministries, all data hosted in the country, during a state of emergency with everyone working remotely.

Open source technologies, commodity hardware, on-premise. Initial load estimates were an order of magnitude lower than what happened. This is the sleepless month I am most proud of.
